recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key composition featuring a stylized feline-inspired metallic mask emerging from deep shadows. The mask is adorned with intricate geometric etchings and sits above a sharp, claw-like necklace. Below the central figure, a multi-tiered typographic lockup uses metallic textures and lens flare accents to create a sense of grandeur and weight.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between the mask and the centered typography
High contrast between the matte black background and the reflective metallic highlights
Visual weight transition from the dark, mysterious top to the bright, textured bottom
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space surrounding the subject
Subtle rim lighting defining the edges of the mask
Metallic, 3D-beveled treatment on the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The mask is centered in the upper two-thirds of the frame, scaled to dominate the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, metallic title block at the bottom center serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top of the mask, follows the vertical center line down through the claw necklace, and rests on the large-scale title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space on the left, right, and top edges to emphasize the 'emerging from darkness' theme.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold/Bronze (warm lens flares and metallic text reflections)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the metallic highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Display text features sharp, triangular serifs and chiseled 3D faces
Secondary text uses a tall, condensed sans-serif with high stroke uniformity
Horizontal bars in the display text are often angled or tapered
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' characters lack a traditional crossbar or use a low-slung, stylized bar
Terminals are sharpened to mimic the claw motifs in the imagery

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed below the subject as a foundation

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, decorative 3D display face paired with a clean, functional condensed sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Golden lens flares at letter intersections
Subtle glow behind the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic cinematic serif skeleton
Matches the tall, narrow proportions of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a low-key image of a black metallic feline mask with intricate tribal etchings, emerging from a black background. Include a necklace of sharp metallic claws below the mask. Use rim lighting to define the silhouette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a centered, two-line title in a chiseled 3D metallic serif font. Apply golden lens flares to the corners of the letters. Add a single line of condensed sans-serif text at the very bottom with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the mask centered and vertically aligned with the text?
Does the lighting feel dramatic and low-key?
Is the text treatment metallic and beveled?
Are the lens flares subtle and strategically placed?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the tribal etchings on the mask
Warmth of the metallic gold accents
Tracking width of the footer text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the frame edges.
Check that the 3D extrusion of the text is consistent in direction.
Verify that the lens flares do not obscure the legibility of the characters.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered, high-detail 3D object in low-key lighting with a bottom-weighted, chiseled typographic lockup featuring metallic gradients and light-leak accents.
